reading.title: Urban Green Spaces and Mental Health
reading.passage: Recent studies demonstrate that access to urban green spaces significantly improves mental health outcomes. Parks and gardens provide essential environments for stress reduction, physical activity, and social interaction. Cities with abundant green infrastructure report lower rates of anxiety and depression among residents. Environmental psychologists suggest that natural elements trigger relaxation responses in the human brain. Furthermore, green spaces enhance air quality and reduce urban temperatures, creating healthier living conditions overall.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one benefit of urban green spaces?
options: B) Stress reduction and improved mental health
questions.explanation: 본문에서 '도시 공원과 정원은 스트레스 감소, 신체활동 및 사회적 상호작용을 위한 필수 환경'이라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What do environmental psychologists claim about natural elements?
options: A) They have no effect on human behavior
C) They trigger relaxation responses in the brain
D) They are expensive to maintain
questions.explanation: '자연 요소는 인간의 뇌에서 이완 반응을 유발한다'는 내용이 본문에 직접 나타나 있습니다.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a benefit of green spaces?
questions.explanation: 본문에서는 공기질 개선, 온도 감소, 사회적 상호작용은 언급되지만, 경제 성장에 대한 언급은 없습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: Remote work should become the standard employment model for all office jobs?

structure.intro: 명확한 입장을 제시하고 2-3개의 주요 이유를 간단히 언급하세요.
structure.body1: 원격 근무의 첫 번째 이점(예: 유연성, 생산성, 통근 시간 절약)을 구체적인 예시와 함께 설명하세요.
structure.body2: 원격 근무의 잠재적 단점(예: 팀 협업의 어려움, 회사 문화 약화)을 다루고 이를 어떻게 해결할 수 있는지 제시하세요.
structure.conclusion: 입장을 재확인하고 더 균형 잡힌 접근 방식(하이브리드 모델)의 필요성을 언급하세요.

useful_phrases: In my opinion, remote work offers significant advantages...
However, it is important to acknowledge that...
Furthermore, companies can address these concerns by...
In conclusion, I believe a hybrid approach would be most beneficial...

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer working in traditional office environments. Others prefer working from home. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my view, I prefer working from home because...
One significant advantage is that I can avoid long commutes...
Another reason is that remote work allows for better work-life balance...
To illustrate this point, I can share an example of how...
sample_points: 집중력 증대: 홈오피스에서는 방해 요소가 적어 깊은 집중력 발휘 가능, 특히 복잡한 업무 처리에 유리
유연성과 시간 절약: 통근 시간 제거로 개인 시간 확보 가능, 자녀 돌봄 등 개인 책임과 업무를 더 효과적으로 조화

listening.title: Campus Library Renovation Project
listening.script: Student: Excuse me, I heard the library is undergoing renovations. How long will it take? Librarian: Yes, we're updating our facility. The project will take about six months, divided into three phases. First, we'll renovate the study areas and computer lab on the first floor. Then we'll work on the reference section and meeting rooms upstairs. Finally, we'll update the technical infrastructure. Student: Will we have access to any services during the renovation? Librarian: Absolutely. We're maintaining a temporary circulation desk and keeping the book collection partially accessible. We've also created a digital collection that's available online 24/7. Many students are actually using our e-resources more than expected. Student: That's helpful. When does each phase start? Librarian: The first phase begins next month. We'll complete it by November, then move to phase two in December through February. Phase three finishes by spring. We'll notify everyone through email and our website about specific timelines and service adjustments.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the conversation?
options: B) Library renovation project and timeline
C) Student complaints about library services
questions.explanation: 대화의 주요 내용은 도서관 개조 프로젝트의 일정과 3단계 계획을 설명하는 것입니다.

questions.q: How long will the entire renovation project take?
questions.explanation: 사서가 '프로젝트는 약 6개월 걸릴 것'이라고 명시적으로 언급했습니다.

questions.q: What services will remain available during renovations?
options: A) Only the physical book collection
B) Temporary circulation desk and digital collection
D) No services will be available
questions.explanation: 사서는 '임시 대출 데스크를 유지하고 도서 수집을 부분적으로 접근 가능하게 하며, 온라인 전자 자료는 24/7 이용 가능'하다고 설명했습니다.
